content: Freshservice and GLPI both add automatic network/agent-based discovery on top of the same core ITAM primitives Snipe-IT has manually (check-in/out, license seats, depreciation). Freshservice bundles ITAM into a broader ITSM suite (tickets/CMDB/contracts) as SaaS; GLPI is open-source self-hosted with stronger native discovery/inventory agent than Snipe-IT. This confirms the manual-catalog + checkout/depreciation/license-seat feature set is the common denominator across all three tools -- i.e., genuine table stakes for ITAM parity, not Snipe-IT-specific quirks.
